title: Sampled queries
description: queries captured by the query-insights Top-N (latency) sampler in the time range

title: Avg latency (ms)
description: mean query latency across the sampled top-N queries (measurements.latency.number)

title: Max latency (ms)
description: peak query latency across the sampled top-N queries

title: Slowest indices
description: which indices the sampled queries target, ordered by capture count, with avg/max latency per index (measurements.latency.number)
